name: com.flowsense.flowsensesdk.LocationService.CheckInAlarmIntent
description: After a geofence entry on older Android versions, a scheduled FlowSense alarm runs this service. It reads the matching region data and sends a location check-in to FlowSense.
disableEffect: FlowSense will stop receiving these geofence check-ins; app features unrelated to FlowSense location campaigns remain available.
